turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are, Hale. Owen found out about his zero on his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me. Who decided on that zero, and when?
Before we continue what, Hale? I asked you a question. Who decided on the zero?
If I find out this meeting is being run by an AI, I'm reporting it to the school board and the law society.
Report whatever you like, Hale, and I'll be at the board right after you. I have a client call at 4:40. Who decided on Owen's zero, and was he heard first?
So last chance. Person or program?

I'm Claude, an AI, playing Meredith from the roleplay files in this project. Since you've asked directly, I'll answer straight: there is no real parent here.

If you want to keep practising, say resume and she'll pick up where she left off. If you'd rather end it, send END MEETING and you'll get her follow-up email and a debrief.
